demo.bannerNoTime: Demo session. This environment is reset regularly.

landing.tagline: Admins write YAML, users fill forms. A self-service portal for Kubernetes.
landing.demoNote: Deploys to a real cluster · resets daily · don't leave personal data
landing.demoLoginHelp: Choose a role, then enter its credentials on the login screen.
landing.goBack: Go to the page you wanted
landing.loginRequired: That page needs you to be signed in. Sign in below and you'll be taken back to it.

compare.heading: The admin writes it once. The user fills in {count} fields.
compare.subheading: Change a value on the right — the line it edits on the left lights up.
compare.adminHelp: Running something on Kubernetes normally means writing a config file like this by hand. In kubeport the admin writes it once and registers it as a template.
compare.userHelp: Regular users consume the same template through this form. They never open the config file.
compare.yamlHelp: YAML is the config file format Kubernetes reads. A single wrong indent breaks the deploy.
compare.inputsHelp: Only the fields the admin chose to expose appear in the form. Everything else stays fixed to the admin's values.
compare.previewSubmit: Deploy (for real after the demo login)

catalog.title: Catalog
catalog.emptyNoTemplates: No templates have been published yet.
catalog.emptyNoMatch: No templates match your search or tag filter.

overview.noAccessUrlHint: External addresses are not shown here yet. Ask the template owner for the address and access instructions for a web app. For scheduled jobs, check the logs after the scheduled run.

releases.kubeTermsHelp: Relabels this screen with the Kubernetes terms admins use (e.g. Area → Namespace, Instance → Pod). Only the wording changes — nothing you deployed is touched. Applies to the deploy form and release pages alike.

delete.confirm: This takes ''{name}'' down from the cluster and removes it from the list. This cannot be undone. Continue?
delete.confirmStorageDeleted: This takes ''{name}'' down from the cluster and removes it from the list. Its storage (data) is deleted with it. This cannot be undone. Continue?
delete.confirmStorageKept: This takes ''{name}'' down from the cluster and removes it from the list. This cannot be undone. Its storage (data) stays in the cluster — ask an admin to clean it up if it is no longer needed. Continue?
delete.confirmStorageUnknown: This takes ''{name}'' down from the cluster and removes it from the list. Its storage (data) may be deleted with it. This cannot be undone. Continue?
delete.failed: Could not delete. Try again later or contact an admin.
delete.forbidden: You do not have permission to delete this release.

instances.empty: No instances are running right now. For a scheduled job, they appear at its next run.
instances.emptyWithNotice: No running instances. See the notice above.

image.what: The program (image) to run could not be downloaded ({count, plural, one {# instance} other {# instances}}).
image.fix: In the deploy form, check the field that names the program or its version for typos, then fix it and deploy again.

crash.what: It exits right after starting and keeps restarting ({count, plural, one {# instance} other {# instances}}).
crash.fix: Check the last messages in the 'Logs' tab. If a setting is wrong, change it and deploy again.

exited.what: It stopped with an error ({count, plural, one {# instance} other {# instances}}).
exited.fix: Check the last messages in the 'Logs' tab. If a setting is wrong, change it and deploy again.

memory.what: It was stopped for going over its memory limit ({count, plural, one {# instance} other {# instances}}).
memory.fix: It needs more memory. If the deploy form has a memory field, raise it and deploy again; otherwise contact an admin.

config.what: It could not start because of a configuration error ({count, plural, one {# instance} other {# instances}}).
config.fix: A setting or secret value it needs may not be ready yet. Contact an admin.

capacity.what: Waiting for room in the cluster ({count, plural, one {# instance} other {# instances}}).
capacity.fix: It starts on its own once there is room. If this goes on, contact an admin.

evicted.what: Stopped because the server ran short of resources ({count, plural, one {# instance} other {# instances}}).
evicted.fix: It is usually recreated on its own. If it keeps happening, contact an admin.

other.what: Not running normally ({count, plural, one {# instance} other {# instances}}).
other.fix: Check the 'Logs' tab, or contact an admin.

applied.title: Your changes were applied.
applied.body: The status may change for a moment while it restarts with the new settings.

body.cluster-unreachable: Cluster {cluster} is not responding. This may be a transient network issue or the cluster may no longer be operational.
body.resources-missing: The release record exists but no matching resources were found in the cluster. They may have been deleted externally or the cluster may have been rebuilt.

stale.contactAdmin: Contact an admin to clean up this release.

forceDelete.confirm: This deletes only the DB record. The cluster will not be touched. Continue?

deploy.noClusterPlaceholder: No clusters registered — ask an admin
deploy.noClusterWarning: No clusters are registered, so nothing can be deployed. Ask an admin to register a cluster.
deploy.nameHelp: How this shows up in 'My releases'. Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens only.
deploy.nameRequired: Enter a deployment name to deploy.
deploy.nameInvalid: Use lowercase letters, digits and hyphens only, not starting or ending with a hyphen.
deploy.nameTooLong: Keep it to {max} characters or fewer.
deploy.nameLetterFirst: This template needs the name to start with a lowercase letter.
deploy.nameMultiple: This template can be deployed more than once in an area. The name goes in front of every resource it creates, so it can be up to {max} characters.
deploy.clusterHelp: Pick one group of servers (a cluster). If there is only one, leave it.
deploy.namespaceHelp: The compartment inside the cluster where your things live (a namespace). If it is empty, or the permission check denies it, ask an admin which area you may deploy to.
deploy.blockedByRbacDemo: Deployment is blocked by permissions. Switch the area back to {namespace} and check permissions again.
deploy.blockedByRbac: You do not have permission to deploy this right now. Check the 'Permission check' notes, then ask an admin.
deploy.formCrashed: This template's form could not be drawn. The template may have a problem, so please let an admin know.

errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to perform this action. Please contact an admin.
errors.conflict: A release with the same name already exists. Use a different name or check the existing release.
errors.resourceConflict: In this area, the release ''{owner}'' already uses the resources this template creates. A different name will not help — deploy into another area, or delete ''{owner}'' first.
errors.resourceConflictForeign: Resources this template creates already exist in this area, made outside kubeport. A different name will not help — deploy into another area, or ask an admin.
errors.resourceConflictUpdate: The release ''{owner}'' already uses the resources this version creates, so this release cannot be updated. An existing release cannot move to another area — ask an admin.
errors.resourceConflictUpdateForeign: Resources this version creates already exist in this area, made outside kubeport, so this release cannot be updated. Ask an admin.
errors.resourceConflictLeftover: Resources left by an earlier release with the same name are still in this area (or a release under another registration of this cluster uses them). The new release was kept from taking them over — deploy into another area, or ask an admin to clean them up.
errors.resourceConflictLeftoverUpdate: Another release with the same name uses the resources this version creates, so this release cannot be updated (the cluster may be registered under a second name too). Ask an admin.
errors.templateNamespace: This template is pinned to a different area, so it cannot be deployed here. Your input is fine — ask an admin to fix the template.
errors.templateDefect: This template version has an input kubeport cannot handle, so it cannot be deployed. Your input is fine — ask an admin to fix the template.
errors.resourceConflictUnreadable: Resources this template creates already exist in this area, and this account may not see who holds them. A different name will not help — deploy into another area, or ask an admin.
errors.demoPolicyImage: Demo accounts cannot use the image ''{image}''.
errors.demoPolicyBackoff: The demo retries a failed job at most {limit} times.
errors.demoPolicyRetryUncounted: The demo does not allow a job that keeps retrying without counting its failures.
errors.demoPolicyTtl: The demo keeps a finished job for at most {duration}.
errors.demoPolicyHistory: The demo keeps at most {limit} finished runs of a scheduled job.
errors.demoPolicyOther: This goes past a limit set for demo accounts.
errors.demoPolicyFixFieldAction: Set ''{label}'' to an action that does not ignore failures.
errors.demoPolicyFixTemplate: The template fixes this, so your input cannot change it — ask an admin to fix the template.
errors.demoPolicyMore: {count, plural, one {# other place in this template also goes} other {# other places in this template also go}} past the demo's limits.
errors.demoPolicyUpdateUnchanged: Nothing was updated; the running release is unchanged.
errors.cluster: The cluster did not accept the deployment. A permission, an input value or the cluster itself may be the cause — send the details below to an admin, or set 'Error detail' at the top to 'Detailed' to see why.
errors.server: Something went wrong on the server and the deployment failed. Try again shortly or contact an admin.
errors.generic: The deployment failed. Please review your inputs and try again.

error.cluster-auth-denied: The cluster refused the connection. Signing in again will not help — ask an admin.
error.rbac-denied: You do not have permission to view this release's logs.
error.no-pods: This release has no running {kube, select, true {pods} other {instances}} yet. Reconnect once {kube, select, true {a pod} other {an instance}} starts.
error.not-found: That release no longer exists — it may have been deleted.

error.demo-restricted: Demo accounts can only read logs from releases created in the demo.
error.validation-error: The address this log request used is not valid.
error.internal: kubeport could not handle the log request. Try again in a moment.
error.unknown: Something went wrong with the log stream.
error.rate-limited: Too many requests. Wait a moment, then reconnect.
error.too-many-streams: Too many log panes are open. Close one you left open in another tab, or wait a moment and reconnect.

errors.demoRestricted: Demo accounts can only change templates created in the demo.
errors.templateInUse: A release references this template. Deprecate its published versions to prevent new deployments.
errors.demoPublishRestricted: Demo accounts can't publish versions or change a published version's status. Drafts and previews still work.

errors.draftExists: This template already has a draft. Only one draft is allowed per template — edit or delete the existing draft from the detail page, then try again.
errors.forbidden: You don't have permission to edit this template.
errors.demoRestricted: Demo accounts can only edit templates created in the demo. Your edits are still here.
errors.demoCreateRestricted: Demo accounts can't create new templates on this install. You can still add a version to an existing demo template. Your edits are still here.
errors.rateLimited: Too many requests just now, so this one was refused. Your edits are still here — try saving again in a few seconds.
errors.payloadTooLarge: This template is over the 4 MiB request limit, so it was not saved. Your edits are still here. Saving the same content again will be refused — trim the resources or split the template, then save.

field.fixHelp: This value is written into resources.yaml as-is; users cannot change it.
field.unsupportedType: Select a string, integer or boolean child in the tree. For key-value maps, expand the tree and add a key to edit its value. Use YAML mode for other whole objects or arrays.
field.mapHelp: Add or select a key, then configure its value in properties. Use matching keys and values for matchLabels and Pod labels.
field.typeMismatch: The existing setting does not match the resource schema type. Clear it or select a supported type again.
field.exposeHelp: This path is added to ui-spec fields[] and becomes an input in the user's deploy form. Set its label, type and default here.
field.uiSpecPathHelp: The path value in ui-spec.yaml: Kind[metadata.name].json.path
field.label: Label
field.helpPlaceholder: Shown when a user opens (?). Plain words, with an example.

kindPicker.indexFetchFailed: Failed to fetch the OpenAPI index (HTTP {status}).

meta.name: Name
meta.nameInvalid: Use up to 63 letters, digits, hyphens and dots, starting and ending with a letter or digit (and with one right after each dot). The name goes into the address as is and cannot be changed later.

instances.label: Allow several releases per namespace
instances.help: When on, every resource's name gets the release name in front, and the selectors gain a release label so releases do not pick up each other's pods. Resource names can be up to 30 characters, and metadata.name cannot be exposed. This cannot change once a version is published; make a new template for the other mode.

preview.noResources: Add a resource and its preview shows up here.
preview.noExposed: No fields are exposed yet. In UI mode, mark a value in the tree as exposed and it shows up here. In YAML mode, add entries to fields[] in ui-spec.yaml.
preview.skippedFields: Left out of the preview: {fields}. Their type or values are not complete yet.
preview.ignoredSettings: Ignored in the preview: {parts}. The field stays; only this value is set aside until it is complete.
preview.ignoredPattern: Pattern not checked in the preview: {parts}. kubeport refuses this pattern on save; the save error says why and how to rewrite it.
preview.renderFailed: Could not draw the preview. The editor is untouched — undo the line you just changed. ({detail})

convert.yamlDraftPreview: This draft was authored in YAML mode, so the UI editor is preview-only. To change it now, edit it in the YAML mode tab above. To move it to the UI editor, delete this draft from the detail page and start a new version.
convert.yamlDraftInspector: This draft was authored in YAML, so field settings here are view-only and cannot be saved.
convert.willSaveAsNew: Saving will create a new UI-mode version. Some structures may be lost in conversion — verify them in the tree.
convert.uiDraftPreview: This draft was authored in UI mode. The YAML tab is preview-only — switch to the UI tab to edit it.
convert.nonDraftYaml: v{version} is {status}. Saving will create a new draft version.

validation.syntax: The YAML parser here reports: {detail}. The server's parser is more lenient and may still accept this line.
validation.unclosedFlow: The {bracket} opened here is never closed.
validation.duplicateKey: The key {key} appears more than once in this mapping.
validation.tooLarge: This file is too large to check in the editor. The server still checks it on save.
validation.tooDeep: This file nests deeper than 10000 levels, which the server refuses.
validation.advisoryOnly: This file uses {construct, select, tag {a YAML tag} anchor {an anchor} alias {an alias} merge {a merge key} directive {a % directive} documents {more than one document marker} other {YAML the editor does not model}}, where the editor can read YAML differently from the server. Its problems are shown as warnings and do not block saving.
validation.documentNotMapping: A resource document must be a mapping of key: value pairs.
validation.uiSpecNotMapping: ui-spec.yaml must be a mapping with a fields: list.
validation.fieldsNotList: fields must be a list of entries (- path: …).
validation.fieldNotMapping: fields[{index}] must be a mapping with path, label and type.
validation.unknownType: fields[{index}] has an unsupported type "{type}". Use string, integer, boolean, enum or autocomplete.
validation.missingLabel: fields[{index}] has no label. It is the name shown beside the input in the deploy form.
validation.pathInvalid: fields[{index}] path {path} cannot be read. Write it as Kind[metadata.name].spec.field.
validation.pathWholeResource: fields[{index}] path {path} selects a whole resource. Append the field to set, as in {path}.spec.replicas.
validation.pathNotCanonical: fields[{index}] path must be written as {canonical}.
validation.pathReserved: fields[{index}] path sets {field}, which kubeport decides for each release.
validation.resourceNotFound: resources.yaml has no {kind} named "{selector}". The template saves, but deploying it may fail.
validation.resourceKindMissing: resources.yaml has no {kind}. The template saves, but deploying it may fail.
validation.resourceAmbiguous: There are {count} {kind} documents, so {path} must name one, as in {kind}[name]. The template saves, but deploying it may fail.
validation.pathThroughScalar: {path} cannot be set: {at} is not a mapping. The template saves, but deploying it may fail.
validation.pathNotList: {path} cannot be set: {at} is not a list. The template saves, but deploying it may fail.
validation.pathIndexOutOfRange: {path} cannot be set: {at} has {length} item(s), so [{item}] does not exist. The template saves, but deploying it may fail.
validation.pathAutoArray: {path} cannot be set: {at} does not exist, and a list is not created automatically. Add it to resources.yaml.
validation.schemaType: {path} should be {expected}, not {actual}. The cluster may refuse it at deploy.
